title: Implement strict allowlist for JavaScript code execution
description: Restrict arbitrary JavaScript code execution via jsCode parameter by implementing a strict allowlist of permitted operations with audit logging
approach: Create a JavaScript code sanitizer that validates jsCode against an allowlist of safe operations (scroll, click, wait, DOM queries). Implement audit logging for all jsCode usage. Add configuration for enabling/disabling jsCode feature per organization.

tasks.title: Create JavaScript code allowlist validator
tasks.description: Create a validator that checks jsCode against an allowlist of permitted JavaScript operations
implementation: Create new file at apps/api/src/modules/crawl/validators/js-code.validator.ts
Define ALLOWED_JS_PATTERNS constant with safe operations: window.scrollTo, document.querySelector, element.click, setTimeout (limited), console.log
Implement validateJsCode(code: string): ValidationResult function
Use AST parsing (acorn or similar) for robust validation
Block dangerous patterns: eval, Function constructor, fetch, XMLHttpRequest, import, require, process, __proto__
Return detailed validation result with blocked patterns identified
acceptance_criteria: Allows safe DOM operations (scroll, click, query)
Returns specific error for each blocked pattern
verification: Unit tests for each blocked pattern

tasks.title: Create audit logging service for jsCode execution
tasks.description: Create a service to log all jsCode usage for security monitoring and compliance
implementation: Create new file at apps/api/src/modules/crawl/services/js-code-audit.service.ts
Implement JsCodeAuditService with NestJS Injectable decorator
Create logJsCodeUsage(context: JsCodeAuditContext) method
Log: orgId, userId, taskId, jsCode (truncated), timestamp, validationResult, sourceIP
Store audit logs in MongoDB collection 'js_code_audit_logs'
Implement retention policy (configurable, default 90 days)
acceptance_criteria: All jsCode usage logged with full context
Sensitive data properly handled (truncation, no secrets)
Audit logs queryable for security review

tasks.title: Create IsAllowedJsCode class-validator decorator
tasks.description: Create a class-validator decorator that validates jsCode against the allowlist
implementation: Create new file at apps/api/src/modules/crawl/validators/is-allowed-js-code.decorator.ts
Import ValidatorConstraint, ValidatorConstraintInterface from class-validator
Implement IsAllowedJsCodeConstraint that calls validateJsCode
Create IsAllowedJsCode decorator factory
Include detailed error messages listing blocked patterns
acceptance_criteria: Error messages list specific blocked patterns
Works with string arrays (jsCode is string[])
Validation is synchronous for DTO validation

tasks.title: Apply IsAllowedJsCode decorator to DTOs

implementation: Import IsAllowedJsCode from validators/is-allowed-js-code.decorator
Add @IsAllowedJsCode({ each: true }) to jsCode field in CrawlOptionsDto (line 352)
Add @IsAllowedJsCode({ each: true }) to jsCode field in CrawlStrategyOverridesDto (line 586)
Reduce @MaxLength from current value to 2000 chars per script
Add @ArrayMaxSize(5) to limit number of scripts
verification: Test with dangerous jsCode - should fail
Test with safe jsCode - should succeed

tasks.title: Add runtime jsCode validation in Crawl4aiClient
tasks.description: Add runtime validation and audit logging in normalizeJsCode method
implementation: Import validateJsCode from validators/js-code.validator
Import JsCodeAuditService and inject in constructor
In normalizeJsCode method, validate each script before returning
Call audit service to log usage (pass validation result)
Throw Crawl4aiRequestException if validation fails
Add request context (orgId, userId) to audit log
acceptance_criteria: Audit log created for every jsCode usage
Blocked attempts logged with full context
Defense-in-depth: catches bypass of DTO validation

implementation: Create test file at apps/api/src/modules/crawl/validators/js-code.validator.spec.ts
Test all blocked patterns: eval, Function, fetch, XMLHttpRequest, import, require
Test allowed patterns: scrollTo, querySelector, click, setTimeout
